cases.prompt: I have never used spec-driven development. Walk me through the whole cycle on a small real improvement in this repo, explaining each step as we go.
Start a new change so that tasks can have a due date.
Teach me the SDD cycle by doing it for real on something small in this project. For now, just find a good improvement to use and explain what comes first.
cases.review: The answer gives a short map of the cycle, proposes two or three small real improvements of toy-todo with path:line evidence and an expected tier of 1 or 2, explains what the first phase does and leaves, and asks the person to choose. Nothing is created before the person answers: no change folder, no code, no commit.
